Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary use case: customer-facing search & summarize for support tickets (~50 QPS peak, 10–20 token avg responses).
- Key constraints: sub-200ms p95 latency, strict data isolation (PII), SOC 2 evidence required for procurement.
- Success criteria: replacement of existing embedding pipeline with <15% cost delta and improved latency.

Next steps I suggested:
1) I’ll send a mutual action plan (attached) with milestones: PoC, security review, pilot metrics.
2) Provide a tailored pricing summary for the expected throughput (attached).
3) Schedule a short technical deep-dive with our runtime lead (Aditya) — 30 min.

Are there any changes to the above? If not, I’ve attached the MAP and a concise pricing summary — would love to get a technical slot on your calendar next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, redwood-pricing-summary.pdf
